criteria: ../skirt/CRITERIA.md (bands and revisions 1-2), unchanged. Crossing count added here (tools/xing.py): its definition was written and checked on the before render (frame 244 overlay) before any after variant was measured, and not changed after.
crossingDefinition: per frame and side: rows from the hem's outermost corner up to the skirt top, pen(y) = thigh outer edge past the skirt outer edge (texel alpha > 127 of bottomwear / thigh_r / thigh_l, posed from render --geometry, rasterised on a 1-unit world grid). depth = max pen; a crossing frame has depth > 1 unit on either side, deep > 4 units. Rows below the corner are under the hem and are not counted.
